body: Fixed all 35 code-review findings on PR #188 (branch mitosis/harness, worktree items-2e991876d93a/trees/harness), touching only the PR's own files. Commits 5d34375 (probe app), 7f9a164 (evaluator) and 90f3124 (drivers), not pushed. flutter analyze is clean, the probe tests pass (75) and the full suite passes (3193).U+000AU+000AFound beyond the brief:U+000AU+002D `$(random_op)` repeated one operation for a whole sequence, because zsh repeats RANDOM in subshells.U+000AU+002D Unquoted `probe_get state?text=0` failed as a zsh glob, which broke plat_origin (every macOS click) and Android's pixel-ratio and column lookups.U+000AU+000AEach blocking and should-fix finding has a regression test in test/tooling/probe/. All 25 new driver tests failed against the pre-fix sources. The evaluator and probe tests were confirmed red with per-fix mutations.U+000AU+000AStill open:U+000AU+002D No harness run has exercised the probe app changes live (owner or main session).U+000AU+002D The GB6 I8 cases are an explicit list of 16 macOS selector cases, not generated from the framework tables.
